problem: Native HT/VHT capabilities omitted RX LDPC, although the original module enables its default policy and HE already advertises the decoder. This also made hostapd omit LDPC/RXLDPC from those capability elements.
factory_reference: rtw_ldpc_cap default0x33; rtw_cfg80211_init_ht_capab0x22e10..0x22e20 sets HT bit0 from RX LDPC; rtw_build_vht_cap_ie0xae0e0..0xae0f0 sets VHT bit4. Actual original instruction gates were executed with enabled/disabled inputs.
fix: Advertise IEEE80211_HT_CAP_LDPC_CODING and IEEE80211_VHT_CAP_RXLDPC. No RF register, rate mask, PN/SN policy, buffer or clock change.

live_capabilities.hostapd_after: ht_capab contains LDPC; vht_capab contains RXLDPC
